title: Google is killing off Gemini's Gems in favor of 'skills' | TechCrunch
summary: As all-in-one AI agents like Meta’s Muse and Instinct take off, Google announced it’s shutting down the Gemini feature known as “ Gems ,” which had allowed users to build custom AI assistants for specific tasks.
